high_level_description: The image is a humorous meme that combines two distinct visuals to create a playful comparison. At the top of the image, there is an illustration of three yellow dragon-like creatures with multiple heads. The dragons have sharp teeth, prominent horns, and a somewhat menacing expression. The central dragon has a more serious look, while the one on the right appears more playful or surprised, with its tongue sticking out. Below the illustration, there is a photograph of three cats sitting side by side. The cat on the left is white, the middle one is brown, and the one on the right is black.
